custom_tou._hours_note: ULO-style evening on-peak 15:00-21:00 (6 h), mid 07:00-11:00 (4 h), off/overnight the remaining 14 h. Weekends off-peak. Global Adjustment is baked into these RPP/ULO commodity prices.

_demand_charge_note: Combined transmission (network+connection) + distribution demand charge for an Ontario General Service >50 kW customer, $/kW of monthly peak. PLACEHOLDER ~$12/kW from standard Ontario GS>50 values — confirm Centre Wellington Hydro's exact $/kW from one actual bill and update.
